{{Quote|Gold One to Gold Three. Be advised, the NovaGun is rotating axially. Its guns can bear on you&hellip; Gold One to wing, Gold Three is extravehicular.|"[[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold One]]" [[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
'''Gold Three''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the third member of [[Gold Squadron]]. There were several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and multiple [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Gold Three.

==History==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ryle Torsyn/Legends|Ryle Torsyn]] used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Gold Three when he flew with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CCGRT" /> Along with the rest of Gold Squadron, save [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], Torsyn was killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

During a simulation exercise to qualify for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Wraith Squadron|new squadron]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] pilot [[Voort saBinring]] used the callsign of Gold Three.<ref name="XWWS" />

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Raynar Thul]] served as Gold Three in the [[New Jedi Order]]'s [[Gold Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gold Squadron]]. During the [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], Thul's [[StealthX]] was shot down by [[Herkan Base]], but he ejected in [[Time/Legends|time]] and survived.<ref name="Conviction" />
